result.summary: 67-year-old woman with metastatic intrahepatic bile duct cancer and palliative-care involvement; this admission included E. coli sepsis/septic shock, toxic encephalopathy, ileus, and hypoxemia requiring supplemental oxygen earlier in the stay. Fall precautions are supported by encephalopathy; no invasive ventilation is documented. A central venous catheter was placed on 10/24, with persistent leukocytosis and anemia on the latest labs; no contact-isolation indication is supported.
result.contact_isolation_reason: Susceptible E. coli bacteremia/UTI, vancomycin-susceptible urinary Enterococcus, and urinary yeast do not establish a contact-precaution indication; MRSA, VRE, and C. difficile tests were negative.
lines: Central venous catheter placed with guidance on 10/24
